name: concept-missing-data: Scooby episode-time distribution shape (no data uploaded)

request.questionText: Scooby-Doo is an American media franchise based on an animated television series (c. 1969) featuring four teenagers and their talking Great Dane dog named Scooby-Doo who solve mysteries sometimes involving supposedly supernatural forces. The data frame in scooby.csv contains information on more than 500 episodes, including a variable called time for the duration of the episode in minutes. The distribution of the time variable is best described as which of the following?
